questions: Does every member pay the same fixed amount each round, or can people pay different amounts, and can someone pay a little at a time or only pay once per round?
Who decides which member collects at the end of a round: do you pick the person each time, or should it follow a fixed order set at the start?
Will you be running more than one susu group in this system, and is it only you using it, or will other people also need to log in and record payments?
answers: No, record whatever each member actually paid; the pot is the total paid in for that round.
